brief:
The International Criminal Court convicted Mahamat Said Abdel Kani, a commander of the Seleka armed group, of crimes against humanity committed in the Central African Republic, Human Rights Watch reported. The verdict marks what the organization described as long-awaited justice for victims of the group's abuses.

Details of the specific crimes and the court's findings were not disclosed in the announcement.
dek: The International Criminal Court (ICC)’s conviction of Mahamat Said Abdel Kani for crimes against humanity in the Central African Republic offers an important measure of long-awaited justice for victims of the abusive Seleka armed group, Human Rights Watch said today.
title: ICC convicts Seleka commander of crimes against humanity in CAR
